WITH claimed AS (
                             UPDATE log_file SET indexed_at = '-infinity'
                             WHERE (hostname, log_ts) IN (
                                 SELECT hostname, log_ts FROM log_file
                                 WHERE indexed_at IS NULL ORDER BY log_ts ASC LIMIT $1)
                             RETURNING hostname, mode, worker_group, log_ts, file_path,
                                       ok_lines, err_lines, json_fmt)
                         SELECT
                            hostname AS "hostname!",
                            mode::text,
                            worker_group,
                            log_ts AS "log_ts!",
                            file_path AS "file_path!",
                            ok_lines,
                            err_lines,
                            json_fmt
                         FROM claimed ORDER BY log_ts ASC
